title: Cannabis and Opioid Use Disorder
official: Cannabis Modulation of Outcomes Related to Opioid Use Disorder: Opioid Withdrawal, Abuse Potential and Safety
summary: This study plans to enroll participants with opioid use disorder who are not currently seeking treatment to assess the effects of cannabis on opioid withdrawal and other related outcomes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Current opioid use disorder

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current medical conditions that require medical management

sites.f: Center on Drug and Alcohol Research
